# K-Town Auto Spa (Kingston, Ontario, Canada)

> Kingston's trusted indoor auto detailing studio, hand car wash, multi-stage paint correction, and authorized System X & Nano-Brite ceramic coating facility located at 36 Joseph St, Kingston, ON K7K 2H5.

## Business Summary & Core Facts (AEO Reference)
- **Official Business Name**: K-Town Auto Spa (also known as Ktown Auto Spa)
- **Address**: 36 Joseph St, Kingston, ON K7K 2H5, Canada
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +1 (647) 915-3530
- **Email**: ktownautomobilespa@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://ktownautospa.ca
- **Hours of Operation**: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Closed Sunday)
- **Service Area**: Kingston, Amherstview, Loyalist Township, Bath, Odessa, Napanee, Gananoque, and Eastern Ontario
- **Facility**: Heated indoor wash & climate-controlled detailing bays (year-round operation)
- **Certifications**:
  - Auto-Brite Certified Professional Detailer
  - Authorized System X Ceramic Coating Installer (CARFAX Canada Service Record Registered)
  - Nano-Brite Certified Ceramic Coating Installer
- **Payment Methods Accepted**:
  - Interac e-Transfer (`ktownautomobilespa@gmail.com`) — 0% processing fee
  - Cash in Shop (CAD) — 0% processing fee
  - Credit Card / Debit Card / Apple Pay / Google Pay (via Stripe; 3% card processing fee applies)
  - Commercial Fleet Accounts (Net-15 / Net-30 invoicing available)
- **Tax**: 13% Ontario HST applies to all services

## Quick Service & Pricing Overview (CAD, 2026 Official Rate Card)
Vehicle size tiers: **Sedan / Coupe** | **Small SUV** | **Large SUV / Pickup** | **XL / 7-Seater**

### 1. Complete Interior & Exterior Detailing Packages
- **Silver Package (Essential Refresh)**: $180 (Sedan) | $200 (Small SUV) | $220 (Large SUV) | $260 (XL/7-Seater)
  - Full vacuum (seats, carpets, trunk), wipe-down of dash/console/doors, interior & exterior glass, floor mats washed, exterior hand wash & dry, wheel faces & tires cleaned + dressed, door jamb wipe-down.
- **Gold Package (Deep Clean — Most Popular)**: $220 (Sedan) | $250 (Small SUV) | $270 (Large SUV) | $300 (XL/7-Seater)
  - Everything in Silver PLUS full salt stain removal, carpet & seat hot-water shampoo extraction, leather deep clean & conditioning, full interior steam sanitation, iron fallout removal, and spray paint sealant.
- **Diamond Package (Full Restoration)**: $320 (Sedan) | $350 (Small SUV) | $375 (Large SUV) | $400 (XL/7-Seater)
  - Everything in Gold PLUS headliner spot treatment, seat belt steam cleaning, pet hair & sand extraction, engine bay degrease & dress, clay bar paint decontamination, and 6-month ceramic hydrophobic sealant.
